284987686.description:
Natural Quartz Geode Specimens
Raw Crystalline Geode Halves
Natural Quartz and Matrix Rock, 2 Pieces
This lot features two natural rough quartz geode specimens showcasing distinct crystalline formations. One piece displays radiating crystalline quartz surrounding an inner hollow, while the companion piece features sparkling druzy quartz lining an irregular cavity with a dark mineral inclusion. Natural geodes form over millions of years within sedimentary or volcanic rock cavities, making each specimen a unique geological study piece popular with rockhounds, mineral collectors, and natural decor enthusiasts.
Two-piece natural quartz geode lot featuring raw, unpolished outer matrix rock
Larger piece exhibits radiating white quartz crystals with a central cavity
Second piece displays fine druzy quartz crystals with tan iron-toned matrix and dark core inclusion
Combined dimensions approximately 7 x 6 x 5 inches; total weight approximately 3.95 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Surfaces display natural roughness, matrix pitting, and inherent crystalline variations. Crystals show natural terminations and sparkling luster across inner hollows. No artificial dyes or synthetic enhancements observed.
